description: This file defines interfaces and external variables related to processing a mail mapping feature within a version control system, including function declarations for reading and clearing mailmaps, and external references to mailmap file and blob paths.

methods.name: read_mailmap_file
methods.description: Reads a mailmap from a file, populating the provided string list with mappings, with optional flags controlling behavior.

methods.name: read_mailmap_blob
methods.description: Reads a mailmap from a blob, populating the string list.

methods.name: read_mailmap
methods.description: Reads the mailmap, likely from a default location or configuration.

methods.name: clear_mailmap
methods.description: Clears the mailmap data from the string list.

methods.name: map_user
methods.description: Maps a user's email and name to their canonical forms based on the mailmap.
